name: PetMedicalRecord
description: A private internal medical journal entry for one pet in a CRM client profile

client_key.description: Stable CRM profile row key that owns this internal journal entry

pet_id.description: Stable pet identifier used to keep the entry attached after a pet is renamed

pet_name.description: Pet name snapshot saved with the entry for historical display

record_type.description: Journal entry type: visit, vaccination, treatment, medication, test, or other

record_date.description: Local clinic date for the entry in YYYY-MM-DD format

title.description: Short required title for the internal medical journal entry

details.description: Optional internal clinical detail written by clinic staff

author_name.description: Display name of the signed-in clinic staff member who created the entry
